properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): 316 of reflow2's 502 defect findings still read open because recording that a fix answered a finding is a separate, optional call (invalidates) that a fix's own record (add_change_event) cannot make; 100 of the 316 are named by a fixing commit, CHANGELOG entry or change record, 64 are backlog rows imported at retirement, and 216 are named nowhere
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause), 2026-10-25, on Anthony's ask after choices_in_doubt on reflow2 returned 163 accepted decisions "in doubt" from 317 open defect findings (a 640,000-character reply).
① MEASURED from reflow2's committed export (docs/design/reflow2 at origin/main 68df725). 502 defect findings: 165 have an INVALIDATES edge, 39 have a valid_to, and 316 have neither, so they read open. Expected: a fixed finding is closed by the fix that answered it.
② PRECEDENT: chg:a-repair-can-say-what-it-invalidated (INVALIDATES and its reader); cap:a-fix-with-no-recorded-cause-and-a-defect-its-subject-outran-are-noticed (realized); dec:every-recorded-breach-still-standing-is-one-open-breach (2026-10-24, which counts these 316 as the open-breach line).
③-⑤ CANDIDATES, each with the measurement that could refute it:
(C1) many were fixed, and the fix never drew INVALIDATES. MEASURED against the commit messages, CHANGELOG.md and ChangeEvent text at main: 100 of the 316 are named by at least one (48 by a commit only, 32 by a change record only, the rest by several). SURVIVES for those 100 at most: being named does not prove fixed, since a commit may record a finding rather than fix it.
(C2) the mechanism: closing a finding is a separate call. MEASURED: add_change_event's fields (affected, change_type, commits, detected_at, id, name, rationale, rationale_basis, repair, stands_in_for, subject, summary) have NOTHING that names the finding a fix answers. INVALIDATES needs the separate `invalidates` tool. By contrast, record_finding draws CAUSES in the same call (caused_by), and the export holds 353 CAUSES against 233 INVALIDATES. SURVIVES as the mechanism.
(C3) many are genuinely still open, a real backlog rather than stale. For the 216 named nowhere, C1 and C3 cannot be told apart without checking each finding against the code. NOT ESTABLISHED.
(C4, outside the tools: process) 64 of the 316 are "[BL-n]" rows that became findings when docs/backlog.md was retired on 2026-08-07 (epoch:backlog-retired). They have no matching decision and no fix path, and were never triaged after the import. SURVIVES as its own slice.
(C5) a recent breakdown rather than a standing one. REFUTED: by the finding's month, closed against open is August 46 to 76, September 72 to 111, October 44 to 48. Roughly 4 in 10 have been closed all along, and October is the best month.
⑥ CLASS: what a tool does in the same call gets done, and a separate optional step mostly does not. CAUSES rides record_finding and is drawn; INVALIDATES is a second call and is drawn about 4 times in 10. The same shape as fact:root-cause-manual-work-reports-stopped-when-end-of-session-capture-stopped-2026-10-25, and req:a-discipline-is-delivered-at-the-tool-not-in-a-catalogue. Until the 316 are triaged, choices_in_doubt and the open-breach line report this backlog rather than news. Fix options are with Anthony.
